decisions.reason: The ID Vault feature was announced with a dedicated press launch in late 2023 and fits the firm's core secure identity offering, so it is likely to be kept in its first full year.
The identity-bound wallet is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with the payment framework, which raises the risk it gets folded in, but it still fits the firm's super-app strategy.
The NFC tag authenticator is a niche product that is only mentioned on the website, but discontinuing it after one year would be unusual for an established security vendor.
The payment and wallet framework has its own page, signalling strategic importance within the firm's platform portfolio.
The multi-service mobile app platform is central to the firm's super-app positioning, even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The application shielding library has its own page and is a core security building block that complements the firm's established products.
